# Publish-ZbxAgentHost

## SYNOPSIS

Adds an item to the session's host for every key the session now answers.

## SYNTAX

```
Publish-ZbxAgentHost [-Session] <string> [-RemoveStale] [-ValueType <ZabbixItemValueType>] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Publish-ZbxAgentHost cmdlet compares the keys the agent session named in -Session answers, its built-in keys and registered handlers, with the items of the host Initialize-ZbxAgentHost provisioned, and creates an item for each key that has none. With -RemoveStale it also deletes the items it created for keys the session no longer answers; it never touches an item something else created. It writes the host's status only with -PassThru, and -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Publish a handler registered after the host was provisioned

```powershell
Register-ZbxActiveAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent' -Key 'app.version' -ScriptBlock { '2.4.1' }
Publish-ZbxAgentHost -Session 'web-agent' -ValueType Character -PassThru | ForEach-Object Items | Select-Object Key, HasLocalHandler
```

app.version gets its item; -ValueType sets the type of the items created for handler keys (Text when omitted, which stores any answer; the built-in keys always get their own).

### Example 2: Preview removing the items of keys the session dropped

```powershell
Publish-ZbxAgentHost -Session 'web-agent' -RemoveStale -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf shows what -RemoveStale would delete, and deletes nothing.

## PARAMETERS

### -RemoveStale

Removes items Initialize-/Publish-ZbxAgentHost created for a key the session no longer answers.

| Wildcards | False |

### -ValueType

Value type for a newly created item whose key is not a built-in one. Default: Text, which stores any answer; give Unsigned or Float for keys that answer numbers, to graph them. The built-in keys always get their own (agent.ping Unsigned; agent.version, agent.hostname and system.uname Character). Ignored for an item that already exists.
